title: Let aeat expedientes read a holder represented through an AEAT apoderamiento
notes: Observed 2026-11-18: with Christian 76048463K certificate and a confirmed GENERALLEY58 power from Andres 09208758H (ref. 20261117105123139004), `aeat expedientes --nif 09208758H` fails "AEAT: Mis Expedientes is not showing holder 09208758H": fetchExpedienteList posts ResumenVlt with empty nifr and never switches the represented holder, while `aeat aportar --como representante` on the same holder works. Smallest next step: reuse the represented-holder switch (bulkFiling/switchRepresentedHolder or the nifr field) before fetching the list, with a fixture test.
